comments.author: MVDijk
comments.body:
For those doing the Naples version, the quest information is misleading. It says they would be sailing north from Sardinia, south of Calvi, but I'm actually encountering them (two times now) on the west coast of Sardinia, south of Sassari.

So my advise would be not to waste time patrolling between Sardinia and Corsica.
